# TextTool

> TextTool is a free, privacy-first, browser-based visual node-graph editor for transforming text, CSVs, logs, and row-oriented lists. All data and uploaded files stay 100% locally in the browser with no backend server.

- Live App: https://chinmayacm.github.io/text-tool/
- Repository & Documentation: https://github.com/chinmayacm/text-tool/blob/master/README.md

## Key Capabilities

- **Visual Node-Graph Pipeline**: Drag and connect operations on an interactive canvas, splice nodes onto existing edges, or use magnetic auto-connect.
- **Lazy Live Previews**: Inspect any intermediate node's output in real time using Head (first N) or Tail (last N) row/character slicing without loading multi-megabyte files into memory until "Process Now" is clicked.
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: No backend server or cloud uploads. Projects and attached CSV/TXT files autosave locally in IndexedDB and can be exported/imported as `.texttool` archives.

## Available Nodes

### I/O
- **Input**: Load pasted text or `.txt`/`.csv` files and split by newline, custom delimiter (`\n`, `\t`, `,`), or keep as a single value.
- **Output**: Evaluate the full graph across complete files ("Process Now"), then copy or download the result.

### Structure & Combine
- **Split**: Break each row into multiple vertical rows by literal delimiter or regular expression.
- **Join**: Combine all rows into a single string with a custom delimiter (optionally skipping empty rows).
- **Merge (Dual-Input A & B)**: Pair and join rows from two inputs side-by-side (or broadcast a 1-row input across all rows of the other input).
- **Unmerge (Dual-Output A & B)**: Split each row horizontally at the first or last occurrence of a delimiter into two parallel outputs (`Output A` before delimiter, `Output B` after delimiter).
- **Compare (Dual-Input A & B)**: Set operations between two lists: Difference (`A − B`), Intersection (`A ∩ B`), Symmetric Difference (`A Δ B`), and Union (`A ∪ B`).
- **Partition (Dual-Output A & B)**: Route rows matching a text or regex pattern to `Output A` and non-matching rows to `Output B`.
- **Slice**: Skip first/last N rows (headers/footers), keep a 1-based line range, or sample every Nth row.
- **Append (Dual-Input A & B)**: Add prefix/suffix text to every row, a specific line, or insert new rows at the start/end/line N.

### Transform & Filter
- **Trim**: Strip leading/trailing whitespace or a custom character set (e.g., `{}, '"`) from start, end, or both ends, and optionally collapse internal spaces.
- **Enclose**: Wrap every row with a prefix and suffix (optionally skipping empty rows).
- **Replace**: Find and replace literal text or regular expression matches (with capture groups, case-sensitivity toggle, and first/all occurrence control).
- **Case**: Convert rows to `UPPER CASE`, `lower case`, `Title Case`, `Sentence case`, `camelCase`, `PascalCase`, `snake_case`, `kebab-case`, or `CONSTANT_CASE`.
- **Filter**: Keep or exclude rows matching a text or regex pattern, or strip blank lines.
- **Sort**: Sort rows vertically, sort delimited items inside each row (e.g., `"a,e,g,b"` -> `"a,b,e,g"`), or both, using Natural (`item2 < item10`), Alphabetical, Numeric, or Length comparison and optional deduplication.
- **Unique**: Deduplicate rows in original order, keep only duplicates or singles, and optionally prepend occurrence counts (`3 × item`).
- **Number**: Prefix or suffix rows with sequential numbers (`1. `, `001: `) with custom start, step, and zero-padding.
- **Extract**: Pull out a specific column index (`1`, `-1`), substring between two delimiters (`[` … `]`), or regex capture group.
- **Pad / Cut**: Pad rows to a fixed character width (start, end, center) or truncate with an ellipsis.
- **Template**: Format each row into SQL, JSON, or custom text using `{row}`, `{i}` (1-based index), `{i0}` (0-based index), and `{col1}`, `{col2}`… column placeholders.
